steps.title: Accept a reservation request
steps.note: The public function receives the available stock count.

steps.title: Send the request to the reservation module
steps.note: The request enters the reservation module through a crate-relative path.

steps.title: Check whether the item can be reserved
steps.note: The reservation module calls its own check.

steps.title: Check the stock count
steps.note: The import alias points to the stock function.

steps.title: Apply the stock rule
steps.note: The parent module accepts a count greater than zero.
